The Pie Oven is a production building unlocked at experience level 14.

It is used to make carrot pies, pumpkin pies, bacon pies, apple pies, fish pies, feta pies, casseroles, shepherd's pies, chocolate pies, lemon pies, peach tarts, passion fruit pies, mushroom pot pies and eggplant parmesans.

Appearance

The Pie Oven is a red brick oven with gray doors and a chimney. A barrel of flour sits next to it, and two wooden chairs and a matching table are in front of it. The floor is tiled. It matches the look of the Bakery, the Popcorn Pot and the Cake Oven.

The mastered version gets a star on the side, another keg of flour and some golden bricks.

Building

It costs 2,200 coin and takes 12 hours (or 35 dia) to build the Pie Oven. It gives players 17 xp when completed.

Upgrading

Main article: Production Buildings

The Pie Oven originally has two slots available. Unlocking the third slot costs 6 diamonds. Players can unlock 7 new slots in total, each new one costing 3 more dia than the previous one. Alternatively, they can spend a total of 105 dia to completely upgrade their machine.

Mastering

A total of 840 hours of production is required to master the Pie Oven:

★
40 hrs 		★★
160 hrs 		★★★
640 hrs
+10% coin +10% xp 15% faster

Strategy tips

  • You can speed up the production of the Pie Oven using a green booster.
  • Most products require eggs. They're common but needed in some other places as well.
  • The short production time like Carrot Pie, Passion Fruit Pie, and Mushroom Pot Pie require mass number from 9 to 16 per boat, all other products required 4 to 8 per item. Therefore, it is recommended to stockpile each of these with reasonable amount.

Did you know?

  • Before the introduction of the Eggplant Parmesan, only the Shepherd's Pie that does not require eggs to make.
